calls.statement:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as return_records,
  SUM(quantity_returned) as total_units_returned,
  MIN(return_date) as earliest_return,
  MAX(return_date) as latest_return
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_product p ON r.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE p.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture'
  AND r.return_date >= '2026-08-03'
  AND r.return_date <= '2026-08-30'
